name: Gas flow switch
summary: A gas-flow switch changes contact state for a specified gas-flow condition.
description: A gas-flow switch changes contact state for a specified gas-flow condition. Its process connection and operating requirement belong in the equipment schedule as well as the control logic.
readingNotes: Do not substitute liquid-flow characteristics for the selected gas device.
